provenance.line_sources: OpenStreetMap highway, waterway, natural, power, railway, barrier; drainages and ridges from D8 flow accumulation at 2 ha
provenance.limits: OpenStreetMap lacks social trails, ranch roads and many fences; most 'no mapped feature' boundary length is that gap. Pooled figures read to about 5 percentage points.

crosswalk.barrier: the analysis's 'fence or power line' class, named for terrain/linear.py's BARRIER line class (power line, railway, fence, wall, pipeline)
crosswalk.corridor_width_m.by_axis.waterway: not a separate aggregate; inferred from the analysis's worked stream corridors (30 m), the same as its drainage ribbons

area_ha_by_resource.note: Only medians exist per resource. A resource's range is the overall quartile ratios applied to its median: p25 = 0.42 x median, p75 = 2.15 x median.

corridor_width_m.classifier: aspect ratio at least 3 and mean width under 250 m; the axis is the interior feature running at least half the length
